messages.subject_clean: loo package repository moved to stan-dev
messages.body_plain:
For any stan-users interested in or already using the loo R package for LOO-CV and WAIC:

The GitHub repository hosting the loo R package has been moved to stan-dev and now resides at https://github.com/stan-dev/loo (it was formerly on my personal GitHub account). To report issues and do any other GitHub-related activities please use the new stan-dev location.
